What’s in your congratulations card

  • A gift box that opens with confetti
  • Your congratulations written out like a handwritten letter
  • Photos of the big moment, with captions
  • Fireworks and spotlights sweeping the screen
  • A teddy with a trophy running victory laps
  • Music of your choice, or your own song

Message ideas you can borrow

You did it! All those late nights and hard work finally paid off. I am so proud of you, and honestly not surprised at all.
Big news deserves a big celebration. You worked so hard for this, and it shows. Cannot wait to see what you do next.
Congratulations! The world just got a little better because you did this.

How it works

  1. Pick the moment and write your words. Add their name, your name, your message, and up to 5 photos if you like.
  2. Preview it for free. Watch the whole card, with sound, as many times as you want.
  3. Pay ₹35 and send the link. Pay with UPI, card, netbanking or wallet, then send the link on WhatsApp.

Questions

Is this good for graduations, jobs and exam results?

Yes. The words are yours, so it works for any good news.

Can a group send one card?

One person creates and pays for the card, then shares the link with the person, or with the group if they want everyone to watch.

How fast can I send it?

A few minutes: choose the occasion, add names, a message and optional photos, preview, pay, and send the link.
